parameters.content:
## Daily Exception Report

This branch builds the daily exception report by identifying jobs that require another appointment, incorrectly completed forms, and forms with missing photos. It returns summary counts and detailed job records, including operative, date, CORF, form PDF, status, and issue reason. The total exception count includes all records across the three categories, so the same job may be counted more than once.

values.content:
=Classify whether the operative notes contain explicit evidence of an access issue that prevented or delayed work.

CRITICAL DATA RULE:
The exact values "Not Answered", "None", "N/A", an empty value, or a blank value mean that no operative note was supplied.
They are NOT evidence that nobody answered the door.
For those values, always return access_issue = false.

Classify as an access issue only when the notes explicitly state that work was prevented or delayed because:

- The tenant or occupant was not home
- Nobody answered the door at the property
- Access was refused
- The operative could not enter the property
- Keys were unavailable
- The appointment or access arrangement failed
- Furniture, belongings, animals, unsafe occupancy, or another physical obstruction prevented adequate access to the work area
- The occupant prevented the work from starting

Do not classify as an access issue when the notes only describe:

- Missing materials or equipment
- Insufficient time
- Technical problems
- Work remaining
- Additional work
- Customer preferences or specification disagreements
- A request for the customer to prepare for a future appointment, unless the notes explicitly say the current work was prevented by inadequate access
- "Not Answered", because this is only a form placeholder

Return access_issue = true only when the notes contain clear, explicit evidence that access prevented or delayed work.

When access_issue = false, access_issue_reason must be an empty string.
